description: This file implements functions for reading and parsing raw data packets in the confui module of the cuttlefish project, including reading raw data from a file descriptor, parsing the data into structured packets, and handling errors.

methods.name: ReadRawData
methods.description: Reads raw binary data from a file descriptor, validates the header, and returns the data as a vector of bytes.

methods.name: ParseRawData
methods.description: Parses a vector of bytes into a structured ParsedPacket, extracting session ID, command type, and payload data.

methods.name: ReadPayload
methods.description: High-level function that reads raw data from a file descriptor and parses it into a ParsedPacket.
